text: Information and Communication Engineering (Information and Communication Engineering) is an interdisciplinary field that integrates information science, electronic technology, computer science, and communication theory. Its core lies in researching the generation, transmission, processing, storage, and application of information, as well as designing and optimizing various communication systems. From everyday mobile phone calls and 5G networks to satellite communication, the Internet of Things, and artificial intelligence data transmission, the technical achievements of this discipline have deeply permeated every corner of modern society and is a core discipline supporting the development of fields such as digital economy, smart cities, and intelligent manufacturing.
